verdict.rationale: Capacities is a cloud-synced SaaS note app; the evidence describes offline-first caching (changes sync once back online) but no local-only mode without vendor cloud and no self-hosted sync backend option — sync always relies on Capacities' own servers. No mention of exporting the full engine, running a private server, or disabling cloud sync entirely. missing for 10: local-only/offline-permanent mode without any cloud dependency, self-hosted sync server option, documentation of data residency/self-hosting.
